title: Distribution to minors; prohibited.
bodyText:
(a) It shall be unlawful for any person to distribute any aerial devices, articles pyrotechnic, consumer fireworks, or display fireworks to minors, except as provided in section 132D-13.

(b) Any person who violates this section shall be guilty of a class C felony.
bodyHtml:
§132D-12  Distribution to minors; prohibited.  (a)  It shall be unlawful for any person to distribute any aerial devices, articles pyrotechnic, consumer fireworks, or display fireworks to minors, except as provided in section 132D-13.

     (b)  Any person who violates this section shall be guilty of a class C felony. [L 1994, c 180, pt of §1; am L 2006, c 183, §14; am L 2008, c 38, §4; am L 2025, c 243, §10]
